tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Find open jobs by role, skill or company, with an optional place, remote, and experience level. Results come from employers' own careers sites first (confirmed open in the last 3 days); when those are fewer than asked for, jobs from Internshala and Unstop fill the rest, each marked with its source.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job a search returned, in full: the employer's description (up to 20,000 characters), responsibilities, required and nice-to-have skills, pay and minimum years when stated, employment type, the apply link, and whether it is still open (seen on the employer's site in the last 3 days), unconfirmed

tools.name: find_similar_jobs
tools.description: Open jobs like one a search returned: the same role, in the same country, remote when it is remote, from employers' own careers sites first. The job itself is left out.

tools.name: check_jobs_open
tools.description: Whether each of up to 50 jobs, by the ids a search gave, is still open: open (seen on the employer's site in the last 3 days), unconfirmed (not seen for longer, so it may have closed), closed, or unknown, with when it was last seen.
